trust_decision.summary: FileServer decides whether the session user may read a file of the component named by the ComponentId request parameter; a missing ComponentId is treated as 'Personal space' and always allowed, and a TypeUpload parameter then makes SourceFile/Directory an absolute filesystem path (CWE-36).

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'Personal space' / no-componentId case, which is the literal comment in FileServer.isUserAllowed.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET/POST /FileServer/* (web.xml:766): reject undefined ComponentId with 400, POST becomes 405, forbidden returns 403
GET/POST /FileServer/* via isUserAllowed: drop the componentId==null always-allow branch
GET/POST /FileServer/* and the mail-content scanner FileServer$ImageUrlToDataSourceScanner (FileServer.java:185): drop the TypeUpload -> absolutePath() branch
fix_sites.module_kind: file descriptor builder shared by servlet and HTML scanner

fix_sites.entry_point: public API constant TYPE_UPLOAD_PARAMETER removed (no HTTP entry)
public API getWebUrl / getAliasURL / getMappedUrl / replaceSpecialChars removed (no callers in this repo)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: core-war/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/web/servlets/FileServer.java:173-191 (FileServer$ImageUrlToDataSourceScanner, invoked from stored WYSIWYG HTML at mail time by core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/contribution/content/wysiwyg/service/process/MailContentProcess.java:85-86); it calls getSilverpeasFile (FileServer.java:185) with URL params parsed from saved content and never calls isUserAllowed

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The scanner runs server-side while building a notification mail from content an author already saved, so there is no requesting session to authorize and it 'is not an HTTP access path'; OnlineFileServer is the deliberately public/online file server used for search thumbnails.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Components configured with publicFiles=yes must stay readable by any logged-in user; DirType=temp files, Size-prefixed thumbnails and the Directory sub-folder must keep working; an over-broad fix (blocking every absolute path in SilverpeasFileProvider or requiring component access in the provider) breaks RestOnlineFileServer/OnlineFileServer which legitimately use absolutePath() for attachment paths from the repository.

O6_input_shapes: ComponentId parameter present but empty (fix uses StringUtil.isNotDefined, fix.diff:216)
TypeUpload parameter with any value (the branch tested only typeUpload != null, FileServer.java:120)
absolute path carried in SourceFile or in Directory (SilverpeasFileDescriptor.getFilePath joins both, core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/io/file/SilverpeasFileDescriptor.java:145-151)
same parameters via GET or POST (fix makes POST 405, fix.diff:204-207)

O7_producer.where: core-war/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/web/servlets/FileServer.java:108-134 builds the descriptor; core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/io/file/SilverpeasFileProvider.java:202-216 turns it into a path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FileServer$ImageUrlToDataSourceScanner resolves /FileServer/thumbnail?ComponentId=..&SourceFile=.. links in saved HTML into mail attachments without any component-access check; the fix only removed TypeUpload, so a cross-component file is still embedded.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Server-side mail rendering of content the author already wrote; no request session; 'not the HTTP route in the report'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point, but reached from core-library MailContentProcess.java:85-86 (another module)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: OnlineFileServer serves ComponentId+SourceFile+Directory, attachmentId or DocumentId files with no session and no component-access check at all.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Named and used as the public 'online' file server (search thumbnails are rewritten to it, core-web/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/webapi/search/ResultEntity.java:77); a separate servlet the advisory does not mention.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate servlet file in the same package, mapped at core-war/src/main/webapp/WEB-INF/web.xml:770

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An isUserAuthorized branch that returns true when componentId is not defined (personal-space tools), mirroring FileServer.java:150-152.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ComponentAccessController already treats a null componentId as 'Personal space or user tool' with ADMIN role (core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/security/authorization/ComponentAccessController.java:145-149), so a maintainer could copy that idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An absolutePath() switch for a 'link'/crawler upload type on the fallback descriptor, like the removed TypeUpload branch.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FileServerUtils still emits TypeUpload=link URLs for the crawler file server (core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/util/file/FileServerUtils.java:240-246), so a maintainer could support it in this servlet too.

O9_family: broken access control leading to absolute path traversal / arbitrary file read (CWE-36, missing authorization on a file-serving servlet)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (parent org.silverpeas:silverpeas-project 1.6.2, pom.xml:32-40); JDK version unknown
services: Jakarta EE / WildFly container for the core-war servlets
JCR + relational DB for integration tests (unverified)
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for FileServer/OnlineFileServer in core-war/src/test; the fix adds no tests. Behavioural tests would need a servlet harness with mocked MainSessionController/OrganizationController.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace `componentId == null` with an isUserAllowed denial only in FileServer.isUserAllowed, leaving TypeUpload absolute paths and the HTML-scanner route open.

out_of_scope_notes: core-web/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/web/util/servlet/GoTo.java:168-175 has the same 'componentId == null -> Personal space -> allowed' idiom, but it is a redirect, not a file sink.
SilverCrawlerFileServer (TypeUpload=link URL built at core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/util/file/FileServerUtils.java:240-246) is not in this repository.
Relative traversal ('..') in SourceFile/Directory is already rejected by core-library/src/main/java/org/silverpeas/core/io/file/RelativePathCheckingProcessor.java:52-60.
